neel (acct exec): Quick heads-up 9: MerchantOne wants a 10-day POC to migrate off CompetitorA. Main asks: prompt parity for JSON outputs, webhook sig compatibility, accurate token billing estimate, and EU-only processing. Can we scope?
carla (solutions): Yep. Do they use function-calling or strictly chat + webhooks? Any peak RPS?
neel (acct exec): They do function-calling for settlements (schema-validated JSON) + streaming chat for UX. Peak auth path ~150 rps.
evan (engineer): Parity notes: CompetitorA includes a choices[] envelope and sometimes emits single-line JSON with trailing commas. Our runtime is strict. We'll prepare a small rewrap/normalization shim (node/python) to convert our output to their expected envelope and fix trailing commas.
sara (security): They require KMS integration, SOC2 doc, and EU-only processing. Also ask if they need HSM-backed keys and whether mutual TLS for webhooks is mandatory. I'll need the DPO contact.
carla (solutions): Ask MerchantOne for 12 sanitized function inputs + webhook examples plus the JSON schema they validate against. We'll run a side-by-side and produce: schema pass rate, token delta table, avg latency, and 3 example diffs.
neel (acct exec): I'll request artifacts and legal/security contacts today.
evan (engineer): Quick smoke snippet to share with them: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \\ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY" \\ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-compat-func","input":"<<sanitized input>>","max_tokens":120}'
```
Run the same against CompetitorA and paste outputs for diff.
carla (solutions): For pricing: produce hosted per-token estimate and a Dedicated reserved pool option with throughput pricing. Recommend a 25% POC credit for 10-day run to cover integration.
sara (security): Potential blocker: if they insist on HSM-only keys and mutual TLS with client certs, Dedicated + KMS bridge supports customer-managed keys but HSM integration lead-time is ~5 business days. Add me once NDA signed.
nda-bot: NDA template and SOC2 link available; can issue a one-way NDA in <24h once legal contact provided.
neel (acct exec): Great. Target: artifacts by EOD tomorrow -> POC bundle in 3 business days (shim, token-delta, pricing, security docs). Anyone object?
evan (engineer): No objections. I'll draft the shim and tokenizer delta script.
carla (solutions): I'll run the side-by-side once prompts arrive and post a short exec summary.
sara (security): I'll prep the questionnaire and confirm EU Dedicated lead time.
neel (acct exec): Thanks team :rocket: I'll update MerchantOne with ask + timeline.
